connector.name: Un Datacommons MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server to query Data Commons indicators and observations (base or custom).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package un-datacommons-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the therealtimex account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DC_API_KEY
env.description: Data Commons API key from apikeys.datacommons.org

env.name: DC_TYPE
env.description: Type of Data Commons to use: base|custom (default: base)

env.name: CUSTOM_DC_URL
env.description: Custom DC base URL when DC_TYPE=custom

env.name: DC_ROOT_TOPIC_DCIDS
env.description: Comma-separated root topic DCIDs for custom DCs

env.name: DC_SEARCH_SCOPE
env.description: Search scope for custom DCs: base_only|custom_only|base_and_custom
